summary: The sweeping attack doesn't ignite other mobs when using the fire aspect enchantment
description:
## The Bug:

The sweeping attack doesn't ignite other mobs when using the fire aspect enchantment.

## Steps to Reproduce:

 - Give yourself a sword enchanted with fire aspect by using the command provided below.

/give @s minecraft:iron_sword{Enchantments:[{id:"minecraft:fire_aspect",lvl:2}]}

 - Summon two cows next to one another by using the commands provided below.

/summon minecraft:cow ~ ~ ~-2.5 {NoAI:1b}

/summon minecraft:cow ~1 ~ ~-2.5 {NoAI:1b}

 - Hit the cow directly in front of you.

 - Take note as to whether or not the sweeping attack ignites other mobs when using the fire aspect enchantment.

## Observed Behavior:

The sweeping attack doesn't ignite other mobs when using the fire aspect enchantment.

## Expected Behavior:

The sweeping attack would ignite other mobs when using the fire aspect enchantment.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Give yourself the enchanted iron sword using `/give @s minecraft:iron_sword{Enchantments:[{id:"minecraft:fire_aspect",lvl:2}]}`
2. Summon a cow using `/summon minecraft:cow ~ ~ ~-2.5 {NoAI:1b}`
3. Summon a second cow next to the first using `/summon minecraft:cow ~1 ~ ~-2.5 {NoAI:1b}`
4. Hit the cow directly in front of you with the enchanted sword, causing a sweeping attack.
5. Observe whether the sweeping attack ignites the other cow.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 15w49a, 1.10.2, 16w43a, 1.12, 1.13.1, 1.13.2, 19w09a, 1.15.2, 1.16 Release Candidate 1, 1.16, 1.16.2, 20w46a, 21w03a, 1.16.5, 21w05b, 21w06a, 21w07a, 21w08b, 21w10a, 21w11a, 21w13a, 21w14a, 21w15a, 21w16a, 21w17a, 21w19a, 21w20a, 1.17 Pre-release 1, 1.17 Pre-release 3, 1.17 Pre-release 4, 1.17 Pre-release 5, 1.17 Release Candidate 1, 1.17 Release Candidate 2, 1.17, 1.17.1 Pre-release 1, 1.17.1 Pre-release 2, 1.17.1 Pre-release 3, 1.17.1 Release Candidate 1, 1.17.1, 21w37a, 21w38a, 21w40a, 21w43a, 1.18 Pre-release 1, 1.18, 1.18.1, 22w03a, 22w05a, 22w06a, 22w07a, 1.18.2 Release Candidate 1, 1.18.2, 22w17a, 22w19a, 1.19, 1.19.1, 1.19.2, 22w43a, 1.19.3 Release Candidate 3, 1.19.3, 1.19.4, 1.20, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 23w51b (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: When the player performs a sweeping attack with the Fire Aspect II iron sword, the cow directly hit by the sword catches fire as expected. However, the nearby cow(s) affected by the sweeping attack only take the sweep damage and do not catch fire. Fire Aspect is not applied to the secondary targets of the sweeping attack.
Expected Behavior: When a player uses a sword with Fire Aspect to perform a sweeping attack, every mob struck by the sweep, including nearby secondary targets, should be set on fire in addition to taking the sweeping damage. The fire effect should apply consistently to all mobs affected by the attack, not only to the mob directly hit by the sword.
